text:
maria_g: Heads up — seeing a spike of prod SSO sign-in failures where users are getting assigned `viewer` fallback and JIT provisioning returns 403. Looks correlated with assertions that include multiple eduPersonPrincipalName attrs + an encrypted custom attr. Anyone on this?

alex_k: Can you paste an example of the assertion?

maria_g: sure — redacted snippet:
```
<saml:Attribute Name="eduPersonPrincipalName">user@example.com</saml:Attribute>
<saml:Attribute Name="eduPersonPrincipalName">user@alt.example.com</saml:Attribute>
<saml:Attribute Name="x-corp-encrypted">BASE64_ENC==</saml:Attribute>
```

ben_p: oh interesting. Our mapping code assumes a single eppn and runs a de-dup/normalize path if multiple — that path currently requires `eduPersonScopedAffiliation` to be present, and because the encrypted attr triggers a KMS decrypt call that fails (or times out) we abort JIT and fallback to viewer.

samira_s: I pulled KMS logs — several `Decrypt` calls returned `AccessDeniedException` at ~1717564300 for the role-key. Could be a rotated key policy.

sre-bot: deploys: no infra changes to okta mapping in the last 30 days. Last config change 1714000000.

alex_k: mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag `auth.relax_multi_eppn_requirements` in prod to true (canary on 10% users) 2) add fallback that selects the first eppn if KMS decryption errors 3) add an alert for KMS Decrypt error rate. Can roll in ~15m.

maria_g: :thumbsup: open PR?

alex_k: PR #3421 — https://git.internal/r/redwood/auth/pulls/3421 — contains the fallback and flag gating.

ben_p: after canary we should push a validation/normalizer change: prefer `user@primary-realm` pattern and emit audit events listing which eppn we saw and which one we chose. Also add unit tests for `multi-eppn + encryptedAttr` combos.

samira_s: Also need to check KMS key policy & rotation logs. If key rotated, the role used by the auth service might have lost decrypt perms. I've asked infra to verify key grants.

okta-bot: Okta webhook retry count=3 for user user@example.com; event id=ok_8f2d...

maria_g: good catch. I'll coordinate with infra for KMS perms and with product to notify any impacted customers after we stabilize.

alex_k: Canary started at 1717564390 on auth-prod-canary, routing 10% traffic. Will post results in ~5m.

ben_p: quick note — add audit metadata `saml_attrs_present` and `kms_decrypt_status` to the login-audit event. We need this to triage future similar incidents.

maria_g: agreed. I'll create the follow-up ticket and own the postmortem if this becomes P1. tagging @security-team for awareness.

samira_s: infra confirmed a recent key rotation for kms-role-01 but the new grant didn't include `service:auth` role. Fix is in progress. ETA 25m.

alex_k: canary green after 6m, error rate dropped ~92%. Rolling full.

maria_g: thanks everyone. after rollout let's schedule a short retro and update runbook for SSO+KMS failures.

okta-bot: webhook delivered after retry; status=200 for subsequent attempts.
